last-train-port.source: REA capture_browser_scenario, headed Chrome, real GPU (Apple M-series, Metal)
states: 1280x720 title: title card with controls incl. P autoplay
1280x720 platform: doors opening at Mango Tide, crowd on the platform
1280x720 boarding: steps out, riders boarding (walkers move between frames)
1280x720 departing: tram leaving the town at 17 km/h, 4/12 aboard
1280x720 peak: cruising on the viaduct over the cloud sea
1280x720 second venue: approaching the Folded Gardens island
last-train-port.results: service results not reached inside the capture windows (a full service runs several minutes; autoplay shows results 3 s then starts a new service, unit-tested)
last-train-port.autoplay: ?autoplay=1 (alias ?autopilot=1, P toggles): skips the title, opens doors, boards riders, departs and balances the lean; loops services
